scripts.db:migrate: env-cmd -f .env pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev --schema=prisma/schema/schema.prisma
scripts.db:studio: env-cmd -f .env sh -c 'pnpm --filter api exec prisma studio --url="$DATABASE_URL"'
scripts.db:push: env-cmd -f .env pnpm --filter api exec prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema/schema.prisma
scripts.db:pull: env-cmd -f .env pnpm --filter api exec prisma db pull --schema=prisma/schema/schema.prisma
